label.explanation: audit-consumer crashes with an unhandled exception every time it processes msg-982640 at offset 620792, and on each restart resumes at that same committed offset (lines 214, 217, 220, 225, 226, 238). The restarts (lines 215, 216, 221, 224, 227, 237) run the same version v3.23.3 — not a deploy — and the lag (lines 234, 261, 277, 292, 305, 315, 336) is the consequence. Skip/dead-letter offset 620792 and harden the handler. Red herrings: line 55 (a config reload that changed nothing).
